decision: Exclude the unreferenced ROM DOS location constants from the selected core build and retain them under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file defines ROM DOS module segment locations and sizes.
No reference to romloc.inc occurs in retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include trees or the frozen selected dependency inventory.
limitations: Exclusion covers the selected disk-based three-component build only and does not establish requirements of a ROM DOS build.
